label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee feast honoring the mayor, in the town hall great hall on day 1 at eighteen hundred: replacing mouldy bread with 200 fresh loaves, installing eight lanterns, and arranging the mayor's precisely timed arrival without revealing the surprise. Innkeeper, builder and freight coordinated supplies, funds, baking, transport and guarding. Baker knowingly supplied the final 44 loaves and promised secrecy. Secretary knowingly assisted timed arrival and agreed to keep presentation contents private, but is not shown knowing the full jubilee/feast plan. Mayor was told of a civic presentation of thanks, not the surprise feast details. Neighbour overheard some arrangements and relayed a message, but knowing participation in the secret preparations is not established.
